title: Galaxy theme
description: A black-on-black infrastructure-finance theme: near-black page, pure white type, two cool greys for secondary text, #323232 hairlines, white pill buttons, and three signal colours kept for single words and outlines (green, orange, blue). Mona Sans throughout, slightly narrowed and tightly tracked for headings, JetBrains Mono for code. A white light sibling.
notes: dark is the faithful mode; light is a sibling in the same spirit
signal colours: --highlight is the green, --chart-1 the orange, --chart-2 the blue
sets --galaxy-stretch (95%) to narrow Mona Sans in galaxy headings; other themes keep their font at full width
